system.description:
Built on Project FU's Hero.

FREE BENEFITS
  • increased maximum Hit Points
  • martial shields proficiency
  • Martial melee or martial ranged (choose one).

(Printed FREE BENEFITS, listed for reference — inert under the no-innate-benefits rule. Benefits come from the creation benefit-pick pool; see rippers-guise. Source: Hero (Fabula Ultima Stuff/Hero_Class.pdf, p.2 (HERO FREE BENEFITS box)).)

STALWART SKILLS

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000241]{Power of Friendship} 【Max SL 2】

+(SL) Bond slots. When you invoke a Bond to improve an attack's Accuracy, that attack deals additional damage equal to the Bond's strength.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000242]{Ties That Bind} 【Max SL 5】

When you invoke a Bond, an ally recovers (SL × 4) HP or MP — and both if the Bond is with them.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000243]{It Was Destiny}

Once per session, spend a Fabula Point to create a Bond, or to add an emotion to an existing one.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000244]{A Hero's Purpose} 【Max SL 3】

Once per session, gain (SL) Fabula Points for saving NPCs from danger, completing a quest for them, or being present when a Villain runs out of Ultima Points. These Fabula Points do not tick the Miasma Clock.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000245]{Resolve} 【Max SL 4】

Action + a Fabula Point: recover from all status effects and regain (10 + SL × 10) MP.
